Emit input speech events on Gemini 3.x Live from `voice_activity` messages

## Today

Gemini Live sessions emit no user speech start/end events. The Gemini profile sets `emits_input_speech_events=False`, and [`docs/realtime/turns.md`](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/main/docs/realtime/turns.md?plain=1#L120-L125) tells users to rely on `RealtimeResponseInterruptedEvent` instead of `RealtimeInputSpeechStartEvent` on Gemini.

## What the API offers

Gemini 3.x Live models send a `voice_activity` server message with `ACTIVITY_START` and `ACTIVITY_END` (and an `audio_offset`) when the user starts and stops speaking ([`VoiceActivity` in google-genai](https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai/blob/main/google/genai/types.py)).

Live probe (2026-09-28): `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview` and `gemini-3.8-live` sent `voice_activity` START/END around each user utterance under automatic VAD. `gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-latest` sent none. The adapter currently ignores the message.

## Proposed approach

- Map `ACTIVITY_START`/`ACTIVITY_END` to `RealtimeInputSpeechStartEvent`/`RealtimeInputSpeechEndEvent`.
- Set `emits_input_speech_events=True` in the profile for the 3.x models only (verify `gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking`, which wasn't probed); 2.5 keeps `False`.
- Update the turns and Gemini docs.

## Timing

Speech-start events drive the session's turn handling, audio retention and barge-in paths, so flipping the flag changes behavior there, not just the event stream. This should land after the in-progress realtime session redesign (see #8801), and be tested against it.

gemini-3.1-flash-live and gemini-3.8-live families, which send them under
automatic VAD; the 2.5 models send none and keep the flag off.

Recorded the gemini-3.8-live spoken-turn cassettes so the event order pins
both sides of the flag, and updated the realtime docs that said Gemini
reports no speech boundaries.
Say which Gemini generation reports speech onset in the event docstring, session comments and docs

Emit input speech events on Gemini 3.x Live from `voice_activity` messages - Closes #9034 ### Why we make these changes Gemini Live sessions never emitted user speech start/end events: the Gemini profile hardcoded `emits_input_speech_events=False` and the adapter ignored the `voice_activity` server message. The Gemini 3.x Live models send that message (`ACTIVITY_START` / `ACTIVITY_END`) around each utterance under automatic VAD, as the probe in #9034 shows; the 2.5 models send none. This maps the message onto the shared events and lets the profile say which models send them. ### New public surface none — `GoogleRealtimeModel(...).profile['emits_input_speech_events']` is now `True` for the `gemini-3.1-flash-live` and `gemini-3.8-live` families (including `-extended-thinking`), and stays `False` for Gemini 2.5 and Vertex `gemini-live-2.5-flash`. ### User-visible behavior ```diff async for event in session: # agent.realtime('google-gla:gemini-3.8-live'), microphone streaming + RealtimeInputSpeechStartEvent() PartStartEvent(SpeechPart(speaker='user')) PartDeltaEvent(SpeechPartDelta(...)) + RealtimeInputSpeechEndEvent() PartEndEvent(SpeechPart(speaker='user', transcript='...')) ... # the reply, then RealtimeTurnCompleteEvent ``` Because the session now sees the end of speech on these models, a turn with input transcription off is recorded at the speech boundary rather than at the reply's `turn_complete`, and instrumented sessions record a `user speech` span. Barge-in handling is unchanged: Gemini still interrupts server-side (`supports_interruption=False`), so only the local flush runs. ### Verification - `tests/realtime/test_google_ws.py::test_audio_in_server_vad_turn` — recorded on `gemini-3.8-live` and on the 2.5 model, pinning the event order on each side of the flag. - `tests/realtime/test_google.py::test_map_voice_activity_to_input_speech_events` and `::test_profile_emits_input_speech_events` — the mapping of each `VoiceActivityType` and the per-model flag. - Re-recorded `test_input_transcription_off_keeps_user_words_out_of_history` and `test_image_then_spoken_question[gemini-3.8-live]`, whose earlier recordings predate the signal; the `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview` parity cassettes already carried `voiceActivity` frames and replay unchanged. ### What changes for existing users Consumers of Gemini 3.x sessions receive the two new events (and the `user speech` span); nothing changes on Gemini 2.5 or any other provider. ### Checklist - [x] No **breaking changes** in accordance with the [version policy](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/blob/main/docs/version-policy.md). - [x] Any permitted **compatibility impact** has a label, warning, migration, release note, and exact API-check waiver. - [x] **PR title** is fit for the [release changelog](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

The behavior is localized and tested but applies automatically to an existing production path rather than being an opt-in additive mode.
